description: Israeli settlers carried out a coordinated overnight rampage across the occupied West Bank, burning two mosques, a home, and multiple vehicles while spraying Hebrew graffiti demanding 'revenge' for the killing of an Israeli in a deadly clash.

faqs.answer: Israeli settlers carried out coordinated overnight attacks across multiple Palestinian villages, burning two mosques, a home, and several vehicles, and spraying Hebrew graffiti reading 'revenge' and 'Jewish blood is not free.'
faqs.question: What happened in the West Bank on July 26, 2026?

faqs.answer: A deadly confrontation on July 25 in the village of Tell, southwest of Nablus, in which two Israelis (including a settler security member and an IDF officer) and four Palestinians were killed. Settlers spray-painted 'Benayahu's Revenge' — referring to one of the Israelis killed.
faqs.question: What triggered the settler rampage?

faqs.answer: According to Al Jazeera, at least 45 mosques have been vandalized or burned by Israeli settlers in the West Bank in 2025 alone.
faqs.question: How many mosques have settlers attacked in 2025?

leadParagraph: Israeli settlers burned two mosques to the ground in the occupied West Bank overnight, sprayed Hebrew graffiti demanding 'revenge,' set fire to a Palestinian home and vehicles, and assaulted workers at a stone-cutting facility in a coordinated pogrom following a deadly clash that left six dead.
location: Qusra, Kur, Beit Furik, al-Mughayyir, West Bank / Occupied Palestinian Territory

mainImage.alt: Burned mosque entrance with fire damage and Hebrew graffiti in Qusra village
mainImage.caption: Fire damage at the entrance of Al-Rahma Mosque in Qusra after settlers set it ablaze, July 26, 2026

methodology: Reported using Times of Israel, NBC News, BBC, Al Jazeera, DW, Reuters, and Middle East Monitor coverage. Attack details cross-referenced across multiple wire services and WAFA reporting. Settler violence statistics from Al Jazeera interactive mapping project and UN monitoring.
